decisions.reason: After two years the organic poultry mini salami has had enough time to reveal its demand, and as a niche, somewhat less central option the value of freeing shelf space and complexity now outweighs waiting longer.
The premium sharing snack remains a close-to-core salami extension with several models and manageable carrying costs, so its option value is still higher than the benefit of exit.
This organic Fleischwurst is a straightforward bio version of a standard category, and after only one year it is still worth keeping on the market while demand settles.
The thinly sliced organic chicken breast line fits the firm's strategic organic expansion and, with several models, allows continued learning without a full withdrawal.

The organic herb-coated salami is somewhat more differentiated and may overlap with other salami offers, but as a recent launch close to the core it is worth keeping for another year to clarify acceptance.
